pages.heading: Catfish
pages.body: Rivers and swamps. Small fish swallow three stacks of items; medium fish hold nine. Large fish swallow one small mob instead. A bucket preserves the contents. Sea

pages.heading: Catfish (cont.)
pages.body: pickles make them release what they swallowed; sea lanterns attract them. Useful for transport, but keep them away from loose valuables and small pets.
